text.style: font-size: 8.1px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle; fill: #9a4d2d

g.text: 退锥未确认或焊后检查缺失：禁止下撤/终镗

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6b78

g.text: 焊后几何检查独立记录焊接变形和可加工性；终镗不能覆盖严格焊后位置度失败。

text.style: font-size: 8.8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #5d6b78

g.text: 冷却计时：t_postweld = max(120 s, t_to_below_55)；408 s 仅为弧燃288 s + 保持120 s 的已知下界。
